# Words crates/isa must refuse. Generated by `cargo run -p kat-gen -- isa`.
# Do not edit.
#
# Fields: word (hex, as an integer), format, why. Near misses of every
# format that has a fixed field -- R, I, S, B, AMO, SYSTEM, MISC-MEM --
# plus encodings of extensions RV64IMAC does not have -- `extension` inside
# its own opcodes, `opcode` for foreign major opcodes -- and the
# compressed shapes the loader expands before anything is decoded. U
# and J have no entry: every non-opcode bit of theirs is an operand, so
# they have no near miss.
